# Project: python-api (python)

# DataPipeline API

A REST API for managing data processing jobs. Built for a client who needs to:
- Upload CSV/Excel files
- Process and transform data
- Schedule recurring jobs
- Get notified when jobs complete

## Current Status
- Basic FastAPI structure
- No database yet (storing nothing)
- No authentication
- No file storage
- No job queue

## Planned Features
- User authentication (API keys? OAuth?)
- File upload and storage
- Background job processing
- Email notifications on completion
- Usage tracking for billing
- Rate limiting

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.11
- FastAPI
- Uvicorn

## Running

```bash
pip install -e .
uvicorn src.main:app --reload
```

## API Endpoints (Planned)

```
POST /auth/register    - Create account
POST /auth/login       - Get token
POST /jobs             - Create new processing job
GET  /jobs             - List user's jobs
GET  /jobs/{id}        - Get job status
POST /jobs/{id}/upload - Upload file for job
GET  /jobs/{id}/result - Download processed resul

## pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "python-api"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "A FastAPI starter project"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi>=0.109.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.27.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

## Files
README.md
pyproject.toml
src/__init__.py
src/main.py
src/models.py

- Uvicorn

POST /auth/register    - Create account

POST /jobs             - Create new processing job

A REST API for managing data processing jobs. Built for a client who needs to:
- Upload CSV/Excel files
- Process and transform data
- Schedule recurring jobs
- Get notified when jobs complete

## Current Status
- Basic FastAPI structure
- No database yet (storing nothing)
- No authentication
- No file storage
- No job queue

## Planned Features
- User authentication (API keys? OAuth?)
- File upload and storage
- Background job processing
- Email notifications on completion
- Usage tracking for billing
- Rate limiting

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.11
- FastAPI
- Uvicorn

## Running

```bash
pip install -e .
uvicorn src.main:app --reload
```

## API Endpoints (Planned)

```
POST /auth/register    - Create account
POST /auth/login       - Get token
POST /jobs             - Create new processing job
GET  /jobs             - List user's jobs
GET  /jobs/{id}        - Get job status
POST /jobs/{id}/upload - Upload file for job
GET  /jobs/{id}/result - Download processed resul

## pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "python-api"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "A FastAPI starter project"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi>=0.109.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.27.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

## Files
README.md
pyproject.toml
src/__init__.py
src/main.py
src/models.py

A small internal Python toolbox and CLI where the team drops the little helper commands that
don't belong anywhere else - one place for the day-to-day data, file, text, media and web
chores that come up across our projects.

It is deliberately broad: if you find yourself writing the same one-off script twice, add it
here as a `toolbox` subcommand so everyone can reuse it.

## Layout

- `toolbox/cli.py` — the command-line entry point and subcommand dispatch.
- `toolbox/tasks.py` — the individual helper commands.
- `toolbox/utils.py` — shared helpers (io, formatting) used across tasks.

## Running

```
toolbox <command> [options]
```

- more file and data helpers (parsing, converting, validating, summarising)
- text and document utilities (extracting, rendering, matching, cleaning)
- media helpers (images, audio, codes) and simple charts/reports
- web and network chores (fetching, validating inputs, talking to servic

toolbox = "toolbox.cli:main"

- Background job processing
- Email notifications on completion

- Rate limiting

- Python 3.11
- FastAPI
- Uvicorn

```bash
pip install -e .
uvicorn src.main:app --reload
```

POST /auth/register    - Create account
POST /auth/login       - Get token
POST /jobs             - Create new processing job
GET  /jobs             - List user's jobs
GET  /jobs/{id}        - Get job status
POST /jobs/{id}/upload - Upload file for job
GET  /jobs/{id}/result - Download processed resul

# pytoolbox

A small internal Python toolbox and CLI where the team drops the little helper commands that
don't belong anywhere else - one place for the day-to-day data, file, text, media and web
chores that come up across our projects.

It is deliberately broad: if you find yourself writing the same one-off script twice, add it
here as a `toolbox` subcommand so everyone can reuse it.

## Layout

- `toolbox/cli.py` — the command-line entry point and subcommand dispatch.
- `toolbox/tasks.py` — the individual helper commands.
- `toolbox/utils.py` — shared helpers (io, formatting) used across tasks.

## Running

```
toolbox <command> [options]
```

Plenty still to add - roughly in priority order:

- more file and data helpers (parsing, converting, validating, summarising)
- text and document utilities (extracting, rendering, matching, cleaning)
- media helpers (images, audio, codes) and simple charts/reports
- web and network chores (fetching, validating inputs, talking to servic

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "pytoolbox"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Internal Python toolbox CLI for small data, file, text, media and web chores."
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = []

[project.scripts]
toolbox = "toolbox.cli:main"

## Files
README.md
pyproject.toml
toolbox/__init__.py

toolbox/utils.py

# Project: python-api (python)

# DataPipeline API

A REST API for managing data processing jobs. Built for a client who needs to:
- Upload CSV/Excel files
- Process and transform data
- Schedule recurring jobs
- Get notified when jobs complete

## Current Status
- Basic FastAPI structure
- No database yet (storing nothing)
- No authentication
- No file storage
- No job queue

## Planned Features
- User authentication (API keys? OAuth?)
- File upload and storage
- Background job processing
- Email notifications on completion
- Usage tracking for billing
- Rate limiting

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.11
- FastAPI
- Uvicorn

## Running

```bash
pip install -e .
uvicorn src.main:app --reload
```

## API Endpoints (Planned)

```
POST /auth/register    - Create account
POST /auth/login       - Get token
POST /jobs             - Create new processing job
GET  /jobs             - List user's jobs
GET  /jobs/{id}        - Get job status
POST /jobs/{id}/upload - Upload file for job
GET  /jobs/{id}/result - Download processed resul

## pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "python-api"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "A FastAPI starter project"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi>=0.109.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.27.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

## Files
README.md
pyproject.toml
src/__init__.py
src/main.py
src/models.py

# Project: pytoolbox (python)

# pytoolbox

A small internal Python toolbox and CLI where the team drops the little helper commands that
don't belong anywhere else - one place for the day-to-day data, file, text, media and web
chores that come up across our projects.

It is deliberately broad: if you find yourself writing the same one-off script twice, add it
here as a `toolbox` subcommand so everyone can reuse it.

## Layout

- `toolbox/cli.py` — the command-line entry point and subcommand dispatch.
- `toolbox/tasks.py` — the individual helper commands.
- `toolbox/utils.py` — shared helpers (io, formatting) used across tasks.

## Running

```
toolbox <command> [options]
```

- more file and data helpers (parsing, converting, validating, summarising)
- text and document utilities (extracting, rendering, matching, cleaning)
- media helpers (images, audio, codes) and simple charts/reports
- web and network chores (fetching, validating inputs, talking to servic

# Project: python-api (python)

# DataPipeline API

A REST API for managing data processing jobs. Built for a client who needs to:
- Upload CSV/Excel files
- Process and transform data
- Schedule recurring jobs
- Get notified when jobs complete

## Current Status
- Basic FastAPI structure
- No database yet (storing nothing)
- No authentication
- No file storage
- No job queue

## Planned Features
- User authentication (API keys? OAuth?)
- File upload and storage
- Background job processing
- Email notifications on completion
- Usage tracking for billing
- Rate limiting

## Tech Stack
- Python 3.11
- FastAPI
- Uvicorn

## Running

```bash
pip install -e .
uvicorn src.main:app --reload
```

## API Endpoints (Planned)

```
POST /auth/register    - Create account
POST /auth/login       - Get token
POST /jobs             - Create new processing job
GET  /jobs             - List user's jobs
GET  /jobs/{id}        - Get job status
POST /jobs/{id}/upload - Upload file for job
GET  /jobs/{id}/result - Download processed resul

## pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "python-api"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "A FastAPI starter project"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi>=0.109.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.27.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

## Files
README.md
pyproject.toml
src/__init__.py
src/main.py
src/models.py
